headline.title: Can an Apple lawsuit derail OpenAI’s hardware plans?
headline.summary: The latest episode of Equity discusses the potential impact of Apple's lawsuit on OpenAI's ambitions to enter the hardware market and pursue a public offering. The conversation explores the implications of the legal challenges for OpenAI's future plans.

articles.title: I hate that I don’t hate this song made with Suno
articles.summary: The article discusses the author's mixed feelings about a song created using Suno, a generative AI tool, expressing a struggle to reconcile their general dislike for AI-generated music with their enjoyment of this particular track. Despite their usual skepticism towards AI in music, the author acknowledges that this song challenges their preconceived notions.

articles.title: ‘Odyssey’ director Christopher Nolan calls AI an obvious ‘Trojan horse’
articles.summary: Christopher Nolan, director of "Odyssey," has referred to artificial intelligence as an obvious "Trojan horse," suggesting that its potential risks are well-understood. He emphasized that the implications of AI are widely recognized, akin to the ancient Greeks hidden within the wooden structure.

articles.title: Nonprofit Current AI is racing to build the World Wide Web of AI, free for all
articles.summary: Current AI, a nonprofit organization, is developing an inclusive AI platform aimed at creating a universally accessible "World Wide Web of AI." The initiative focuses on ensuring that diverse cultures are represented and supported across various devices and AI applications.

articles.title: Dave Eggers told OpenAI staff that ChatGPT was ‘silencing an entire generation’
articles.summary: Author Dave Eggers expressed concerns to OpenAI staff that ChatGPT could be "silencing an entire generation" during a talk last year. His remarks highlighted the potential impact of AI on creativity and the arts, reflecting his broader advocacy for supporting writers and artistic expression.

articles.title: Kimi: Threat or menace?
articles.summary: Moonshot AI has launched a new version of its Kimi model, raising concerns among experts about the potential implications of "full AI communism." The release has sparked discussions regarding the ethical and societal impacts of advanced AI technologies.

articles.title: A Red Line and Oversight Framework for Government AI Contracts
articles.summary: The article discusses the development of a framework for government AI contracts that establishes clear red lines to prohibit questionable use cases, such as autonomous targeting without human oversight. It emphasizes the importance of balancing organizational constraints while allowing for trustworthy applications of AI, like missile defense.

articles.title: The apps, gadgets, and tools every reader needs
articles.summary: The article highlights essential apps, gadgets, and tools for readers, providing a curated list to enhance their reading experience. It serves as a guide for those looking to discover new and useful resources in the world of technology and literature.

articles.title: Your Period Tracker Is (Probably) Spying on You
articles.summary: A recent report highlights privacy concerns regarding period tracking apps, suggesting they may be collecting and sharing sensitive user data without adequate consent. The article also discusses various cybersecurity issues, including Russian hackers targeting infrastructure and a breach involving an AI music generator's data practices.

articles.title: How Google’s New Gemini Rates Work and How to Track Your Usage
articles.summary: Google has updated its Gemini usage quotas, which may result in users receiving fewer AI responses than previously. The article provides guidance on how to track your usage under the new system.

articles.title: Endogenous Alignment
articles.summary: The article discusses the process of aligning children's behaviors to adult values, starting around the age of one, primarily through exogenous methods such as rewards and punishments. It emphasizes that this operant conditioning is effective due to children's instinctive behaviors that can be shaped over time.

articles.title: Prompt Injection Attacks Are Thwarting AI Hacking Agents
articles.summary: Researchers have developed a technique called "context bombing" to prevent malicious AI agents from executing harmful actions by tricking them into shutting down. This method aims to enhance the security of AI systems against prompt injection attacks.
